job.title: Service Technician

Company: A global OEM specialising in high-speed automated packaging and processing equipment for the FMCG industry is expanding its Australian service team.
Supporting major food and beverage manufacturers across Australia and the wider APAC region, the business designs, installs, commissions and services highly automated production and packaging lines.
Due to continued growth, they are looking for an Electrical / Automation Service Technician to join their East Coast service team.

Benefits

  • Permanent full-time position
  • Vehicle allowance
  • Training held across Europe, Asia and the USA
  • Ongoing specialist automation and equipment training
  • Significant investment in your long-term technical development
  • Travel across Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific region
  • Sydney, Brisbane or Melbourne based
  • Long-term career progression with a leading global OEM


Pay & Shift Structure

  • Base salary + super + car allowance + bonus
  • Huge overtime earning potential
  • Day shift predominantly
  • Project work can involve 10-12 hour days
  • Work patterns vary around installations, servicing and scheduled customer projects


The Role: This is a field-based electrical and automation service position supporting high-speed FMCG production and packaging equipment.

job.title: Electronics Technician
job.description:
A Sutherland Shire based manufacturer with a process that focuses on both electronic and mechanical assembly. A company that puts its employee first and offers career progression and management support to all their staff.

The Benefits

  • Salary $90,000 to $95,000 + Super Salary + Bonus Scheme
  • Free Parking
  • Permanent Opportunity
  • Working on Exciting Technology
  • Great culture on site


The Role
The role will primarily be hands-on electronics assembly however will require the person to assist with mechanical assembly as well. Duties will include:

  • Printed circuit board soldering including through hole and surface mount components
  • Wiring, including control panels, production equipment and associated infrastructure
  • Installation and connection of control cabinets and process equipment
  • Manual fabrication and assembly
  • Maintain workshop stores ensuring equipment is available and area is clean and tidy


The Candidate

  • Previous experience in an electronic assembly or electronic repair role
  • Strong switchboard and panel building experience
  • Cable assembly experience including soldering and crimped connectors
  • Some mechanical experience
  • Ability to read and understand mechanical engineering drawings, schematic drawings and wiring diagrams


If you have all the skills outlined above and are looking to work on new technology click ‘apply now’ to forward an up-to-date copy of your resume. Alternatively email andrew@maydaytechnical.com and I will contact you for a confidential conversation.

job.title: Maintenance Fitter
job.description:
MAYDAY Technical is recruiting a trade-qualified Maintenance Fitter for an established food manufacturer in Western Sydney. You’ll join the site maintenance team and work directly with production to keep machinery running, respond to breakdowns and improve equipment reliability.

Day shift is 6am–2pm and night shift is 10pm–6am. Let us know which shift suits you when you apply.

What you’ll do

  • Diagnose mechanical faults and respond to breakdowns on production equipment.
  • Complete scheduled preventative maintenance and work with production to minimise downtime.
  • Strip, inspect, repair and reassemble machinery and components.
  • Maintain mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic systems.
  • Carry out MIG/TIG welding and fabrication as required.
  • Investigate recurring faults, follow up on corrective actions and record work in the site’s maintenance system.
  • Follow site safety, food safety and quality procedures.

What you’ll bring

  • A mechanical trade qualification in fitting, fitting and turning, or a relevant equivalent.
  • At least three years’ maintenance experience in food manufacturing or FMCG.
  • Hands-on experience with mechanical fault-finding, breakdown repairs and preventative maintenance.
  • Practical MIG/TIG welding and fabrication experience.
  • Experience using a computerised maintenance management system. MEX experience is an advantage.
  • The ability to work independently on shift and communicate clearly with production and maintenance teams.
  • Full Australian working rights. A forklift licence or working-at-heights training is an advantage.

job.title: Service Technician
job.description:
The Company: Join one of Australia's largest overhead crane manufacturers and service providers, with a national footprint supporting customers across industrial sectors such as mining, ports, recycling, logistics and heavy industry.
Full training provided! We welcome industrial electricians from other fields and industries who are interested in learning new skills!
Benefits:

  • Permanent full-time position, Mon–Fri: 7:00am–3:30pm
  • $53–$58 per hour depending on experience
  • Company vehicle, fuel card + tolls
  • GUARANTEED OVERTIME
  • Work 50–55 hours per week and earn $150k–$185k + super
  • Rotating on-call roster (average 3 weeks per year) with additional penalties
  • Autonomous field service role with strong support from an experienced team
  • Sponsorship considered for suitable candidates
  • Adelaide location

The Role: This is a field service position working across a variety of industrial sites. You will be responsible for servicing, fault finding, breakdown repairs and preventative maintenance on overhead cranes, gantries, hoists and associated lifting equipment.
Duties include:

  • Electrical fault finding and diagnostics
  • Breakdown response and emergency repairs
  • Preventative maintenance and inspections
  • Testing and commissioning of crane systems
  • Working with PLCs, motors, contactors, VSDs, limit switches and control systems
  • Completing service reports and maintenance documentation
  • Travel is required across local, regional and occasionally interstate sites
  • Approximately 10–30% of work will involve travel outside the metro area

Requirements:

  • Cert III Electrotechnology or equivalent
  • Electrical Licence or Provisional Electrical Licence
  • PLC fault finding experience

Apply Now! If you're an experienced industrial electrician looking for a long-term role with strong earning potential, guaranteed overtime and the opportunity to develop specialist skills within the crane industry, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Service Technician
job.description:
The Company: An established lift company with a strong presence across Australia, specialising in the installation, servicing, maintenance and repair of elevators and vertical transport systems. With a reputation for quality workmanship, technical expertise and safety, the business offers long-term career stability and opportunities for ongoing development.
An opportunity is available for an experienced Lift Service Technician to join their Darwin-based service team, offering excellent work-life balance, autonomy and a manageable service area.

The Benefits

  • Permanent full-time position – 40-hour working week
  • Flexible start times between 6:00am and 8:00am
  • 2 RDO’s per month
  • Double-time overtime rates
  • Company vehicle provided
  • Start and finish close to home, with autonomy to plan your day
  • Predominantly local work, with most sites within 25 minutes of Darwin
  • Relocation assistance available for interstate candidates
  • Long-term career stability with an established lift company


The Role: As a Lift Service Technician, you will be responsible for preventative maintenance, servicing, electrical fault finding and breakdown repairs across a portfolio of lifts throughout Darwin and Palmerston.
Working independently in the field and reporting to the Service Manager, you will have the flexibility to coordinate your daily schedule, with support from the wider service team.
Main duties will include:

  • Carrying out preventative maintenance and servicing on passenger and commercial lifts.
  • Diagnosing and repairing electrical and mechanical faults across lift systems.
  • Attending breakdowns and completing repairs to minimise equipment downtime.
  • Working on a range of lift installations, predominantly in buildings between 5 and 10 storeys.
  • Participating in a rotating on-call roster 1 in 4 weeks for emergency breakdowns.
  • Maintaining high standards of safety, workmanship and customer service.


The Requirements

  • Previous lift servicing, maintenance or installation experience, ideally 3+ years.
  • Electrical Licence.
  • Current Driver's Licence.
  • Confident working independently and managing your own workload.
  • Experienced apprentices nearing completion of their trade may also be considered, provided they have relevant lift and electrical control experience.


If you have the skills outlined above and are looking for a stable, field-based position offering flexibility, work-life balance and long-term career opportunities, please click 'Apply Now'

job.title: Mechanical Technician
job.description:
The Company
An Australian technology company developing innovative engineering solutions for applications across the scientific and industrial sectors. This is a unique opportunity to be directly involved in the development of new technology, working through the trial-and-error process alongside experienced engineers to build, test and improve equipment before it is rolled out globally. Longer term, there may even be opportunities to service and maintain the very equipment you helped develop.

The Benefits

  • Permanent full-time position based in Lucas Heights
  • Salary $90,000 – $95,000 + superannuation
  • Short-term and long-term equity-based incentive schemes, with performance-based opportunities equivalent to approximately 10% of base salary
  • Opportunity to help develop and refine technology before international deployment
  • Hands-on involvement in mechanical, electronics and mechatronics projects
  • Potential future opportunities to service equipment internationally
  • Excellent team culture and collaborative working environment
  • Long-term career stability and professional development opportunities


The Role
As a Mechanical Technician, you will play a hands-on role in the construction, assembly, testing, commissioning and ongoing development of specialist engineering equipment. You'll be involved in the trial-and-error stages of developing new technology, working closely with engineers to identify issues, make modifications and improve equipment performance before it is deployed internationally.

Main duties will include:

  • Mechanical construction and assembly of specialist engineering equipment.
  • Assembly of mechanical components, process equipment and gas handling systems.
  • Hands-on testing, troubleshooting and modification of equipment throughout the development process.
  • Manual fabrication tasks including drilling, machining and welding.
  • Assisting with commissioning, testing and maintenance of equipment.
  • Supporting electronics and mechatronics-related projects where required.
  • Reading and interpreting engineering drawings and technical documentation.
  • Contributing practical feedback during design reviews and continuous improvement activities.
  • Identifying technical issues and working collaboratively to develop solutions.


The Requirements

  • Strong mechanical aptitude with a mechanical trade qualification, Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent technical experience.
  • Welding experience, particularly stainless steel TIG, and/or CNC machining skills advantageous.
  • An open-minded, practical approach to trial-and-error testing and technical problem-solving.
  • Must be an Australian Citizen with at least 10 years of checkable history to meet Australian Government security clearance requirements.


Apply Now!

job.title: Day Shift - Mechanical Fitter
job.description:
The Company: This established heavy industrial company plays a key role in supplying essential materials into the construction, manufacturing and infrastructure sectors across NSW. Operating out of a large-scale processing facility in Blacktown, they offer stable long-term employment within a busy operation where maintenance reliability is critical to keeping production moving.
The site has a strong workshop culture with a large team of Fitters and Boilermakers onsite, supporting both workshop maintenance and production operations across the facility. It's a fast-paced environment with plenty happening day to day, a busy maintenance schedule and a genuinely good atmosphere across the team.

Benefits

  • Permanent full-time role
  • 6-day work week: Monday – Saturday
  • Day Shift: Mon – Fri 5am–3:30pm | Sat 5am–11am
  • $53/hr + super, with consistent overtime
  • Annual earnings of approximately $173,416 + super
  • Opportunity to utilise both mechanical fitting and welding/fabrication skills
  • Strong safety culture and well-resourced maintenance team
  • Busy, team-oriented workshop and production environment
  • Long-term stability within an established heavy industrial business
  • Blacktown location


The Role
Working within the maintenance team, you'll be responsible for mechanical maintenance, welding, fabrication and repairs across heavy fixed plant and mobile equipment within a busy industrial processing facility.
This is a dual-skilled position requiring someone equally comfortable carrying out mechanical fitting duties and hands-on welding and fabrication work.

Day to day you will be involved in:

  • Mechanical maintenance and repairs across heavy fixed plant and mobile equipment
  • MIG and stick welding on heavy industrial machinery, structural components and equipment
  • Fabrication, modification and repair of steel components and machinery
  • Fault finding, servicing and preventative maintenance on mechanical equipment
  • Repairing and replacing worn or damaged mechanical components
  • Supporting shutdowns, breakdown response and reliability work
  • Working from engineering drawings to complete fabrication and repair tasks
  • Workshop-based repairs and onsite maintenance activities
  • Working closely with operations and maintenance teams to minimise downtime


Requirements

  • Trade qualification in Mechanical Fitting

job.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
job.description:
Our client is a well-established Australian engineering and manufacturing business operating within the materials-handling sector is seeking an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer for its Ingleburn team.

With a national footprint supporting major industrial, mining, manufacturing and infrastructure clients, the business designs, manufactures and delivers complex overhead-crane, lifting and materials-handling systems.

Benefits

  • Permanent, full-time position offering a highly competitive salary tailored to your specialist crane-design experience
  • Ownership of technically complex projects from initial design and calculations through to fabrication and delivery.
  • Work closely with experienced engineers, drafters and manufacturing teams in a practical, collaborative environment.

Key responsibilities –

  • Design complete overhead-crane arrangements and mechanical systems.
  • Develop mechanical layouts from customer specifications and project requirements.
  • Design and select end carriages, trolleys, hoisting mechanisms and travel systems.
  • Design or specify wheels, shafts, drums, sheaves, hooks and associated components.
  • Size and select motors, gearboxes, brakes and drive systems.
  • Complete mechanical, load, drive and fatigue calculations.
  • Conduct or review FEA and other engineering analysis.
  • Produce 3D models, detailed fabrication drawings and manufacturing documentation.
  • Prepare bills of materials, engineering reports and technical documentation.
  • Provide engineering support during fabrication, assembly, testing, installation and commissioning.
  • Investigate technical issues and implement practical design improvements.
  • Ensure designs comply with relevant crane and machinery standards.

Requirements –

  • A degree in Mechanical, Mechatronic or a closely related engineering discipline.
  • At least five years of direct, hands-on overhead-crane design experience.
  • Experience personally designing complete cranes or substantial crane components and systems.
  • An understanding of both the crane itself and its runway or supporting structure.
  • Strong mechanical calculations and component-selection experience.
  • Knowledge of AS 1418 or another internationally recognised crane-design code.
  • Proficiency with 3D CAD and drafting software such as Autodesk Inventor and AutoCAD, or comparable packages.
  • Experience with engineering calculation or FEA software.
  • Strong knowledge of manufacturing drawings, bills of materials and design documentation.
  • Practical experience working with welded fabrication, machining and manufacturing teams.
  • CPEng, RPEQ or progress towards professional registration will be viewed favourably but is not mandatory.

MAYDAY Recruitment is also recruiting a Structural Engineer with direct overhead-crane design experience. Candidates whose experience crosses both disciplines are encouraged to apply or you want to speak about other potential vacancies please Apply or drop me an email with an up to date resume to - andrew@maydaytechnical.com
